title: Classify European conditional packed lookup
changes: Document the source-backed EUR type-5 conditional lookup projection at indices 1 through 33 and preserve other readers and existing-owner aliases.
validation: Checked six original Wine disassemblies, exact EUR ROM and e96 manifest, and 42 type-5 source descriptors over 23 pointer intervals with witnesses for every selected index.
limitations: Source witnesses do not establish every ordinary selection, a global index limit, row zero or the final pointer interval. Runtime, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurements.
